answer: No, you should not be taking lisinopril. Dr. Elena Marsh at Fernhill Family Clinic stopped it on September 22, 2025, because it was causing a dry cough, and switched you to losartan 50 mg once a day. At your December 9, 2025 visit the cough had resolved. At your June 15, 2026 visit your blood pressure was at goal and the note says to continue your current medicines, which include losartan. The app that still lists lisinopril is most likely showing an old copy: a Kestrel Harbor Hospital record dated March 29, 2025, from before the change. Please do not restart lisinopril, and ask your pharmacy or clinic to remove it from your list. Your records also list lisinopril as a reaction (cough), so tell any new prescriber about that. I can only see what is in your records, so if you have any doubt about your current medicines, confirm with Dr. Marsh's office.
short: Lisinopril was stopped on 9/22/2025 for dry cough and replaced by losartan 50 mg daily. The app listing it is an outdated March 2025 hospital record. Please confirm with Dr. Marsh and do not restart lisinopril.
